title: SP-DocReader: Difference-Aware Self-Play for Precise Document OCR
abstract: arXiv:2610.11148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate page transcription remains difficult for vision language models under limited input and training budgets. We present SP-DocReader, a self-play framework for optical character recognition (OCR) that targets residual errors after supervised fine-tuning. Reading Discrepancy Masking aligns reference and generated model tokens through a longest common subsequence, then scores unmatched positions with their full conditioning prefixes. Focused Fidelity Loss adds direct negative log-likelihood supervision at unmatched ground-truth positions. Only the OCR module is trained, while the backbone remains frozen. We derive the combined gradient to distinguish relative score optimization from direct supervision. Compared with SFT-2, SP-DR-3 reduces Vary-600K character error rate on both backbones. On Qwen3-VL-4B, it reduces character error rate by approximately 54 percent and improves DocVQA Average Normalized Levenshtein Similarity (ANLS) b

translated_title: SP-DocReader：面向精准文档OCR的差分感知自博弈方法
translated_abstract: 在有限的输入和训练预算下，视觉语言模型仍难以实现精确的页面转录。我们提出了SP-DocReader，一个针对光学字符识别（OCR）的自博弈框架，专门解决监督微调后残留的错误。阅读差异掩码通过最长公共子序列对齐参考token与模型生成的token，然后利用完整的条件前缀对未匹配的位置进行评分。聚焦保真度损失则在未匹配的真实标签位置添加直接的负对数似然监督。该方法仅训练OCR模块，而骨干网络保持冻结。我们推导了组合梯度，以区分相对得分优化与直接监督。与SFT-2相比，SP-DR-3在两种骨干网络上均降低了Vary-600K数据集的字符错误率。在Qwen3-VL-4B上，它将字符错误率降低了约54%，并提升了DocVQA的平均归一化Levenshtein相似度（ANLS）……
tldr: SP-DocReader是一个面向文档OCR的自博弈框架，通过阅读差异掩码和聚焦保真度损失，在仅训练OCR模块、冻结骨干网络的条件下，显著降低监督微调后的残留字符错误率（在Qwen3-VL-4B上降低约54%）。
en_tdlr: SP-DocReader is a self-play OCR framework that combines Reading Discrepancy Masking and Focused Fidelity Loss, training only the OCR module while freezing the backbone, to substantially reduce residual character error rates after supervised fine-tuning (by approximately 54% on Qwen3-VL-4B).
